mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as companies adjust to increased productivity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances during a monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% MoM and unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2pp, it signals robust consumer demand and labor market tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS MoM > 1% and UNRATE MoM < -0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% MoM, it signals strong economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ > 0% and HOUST MoM > 5%.
